subject: Azure Partner Center referral — Contoso onboarding & seller ownership decisions
messages:
From: Sean Murphy <sean.murphy@contoso.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rachel Lee <rachel.lee@contoso.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Azure Partner Center referral for Contoso — next steps

Hi Ava,

Thanks for taking this — Contoso is ready to publish our managed solution to Azure Marketplace and we want to enable Partner Center referrals (co-sell) as part of the launch. We expect ~200 target customer accounts to be eligible; getting the field sellers correctly mapped is critical for our sales motion.

Can you help with: 
- A recommended owner-mapping approach for Partner Center referrals (by region / ARR band / existing MS relationship)
- The minimal data we should provide to Azure to ensure referrals route to the right sellers
- A rough timeline for intake -> Partner Center listing -> referrals enabled

We can share an SFTP of Contoso account IDs and an initial owner roster if that helps. Attaching the product spec and our internal account tiles.

Thanks,
Sean
Sean Murphy
Director, Cloud Partnerships
Contoso

Attachments: contoso_account_tiles_v1.csv (stub), contoso_product_spec.pdf (stub)

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Murphy <sean.murphy@contoso.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure Partner Center referral for Contoso — next steps

Hi Sean — great to meet you over email. Looping in Karthik (partner success / field ops) and Vanessa (channel & marketplace ops) who will lead the mapping and intake work.

Short answers up front:
- We typically map Partner Center referrals using a prioritized rule-set: explicit seller ownership (you provide), then MS seller match (Partner Center signal), then regional default if no match.
- Minimal data: primary account ID (Account GUID), account name, estimated ARR band, primary region, and any existing MS seller alias or MCC owner.
- Timeline: intake + verification (3–5 business days), Partner Center intake + listing association (7–10 business days), referral routing enabled (1–2 business days after association).

Next steps I propose:
1) Karthik will ingest your account tile CSV and produce a proposal mapping CSV with suggested owner/backup owner and confidence scores.
2) Vanessa will file the Partner Center intake ticket and coordinate the PC engineering check.
3) We run a 50-account pilot for referral routing before flipping the full set.

Karthik/Vanessa — can you confirm you can take the tiles and produce the mapping + pilot plan? Sean — please send the account tile CSV (or SFTP link) and a point-of-contact for any missing fields.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: pc_referral_flow_v2.pdf (internal flow doc)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed mapping rules and sample tiles (Contoso)

Ava / Vanessa — I pulled the Contoso tiles that Sean shared and put together a first-cut mapping. Key notes:

Mapping heuristics used (first-pass):
- If Contoso provided an explicit seller alias -> assign to that seller (owner_type = explicit).
- Else if Partner Center returned an active MS seller on the account -> use MS seller as owner (owner_type = ms_signal).
- Else map by region + ARR bucket to a regional field seller (owner_type = regional_fallback).
- Set a backup owner from the same region with lower confidence.

Pilot plan: 50 accounts, split by region (30 US west/central, 10 EMEA, 10 APAC), run referrals in Partner Center with monitoring for 48 hours. If misroutes > 5% we revert and iterate.

I've attached the sample mapping CSV: contoso_account_tiles_v1_mapped.csv (stub) — columns: account_guid, account_name, arr_band, region, owner_seller, owner_type, confidence_score, notes.

Open questions:
- Does Contoso want to preserve their internal CS owner as a suggested recipient, or should we prioritize Microsoft seller match? My recommendation: preserve Contoso suggestions but use MS seller match as higher priority for co-sell routing to avoid duplicate outreach.
- Any accounts that are under active enterprise deals with MS (MCA or delegated reseller)? Those require manual verification.

I'll drop the mapping into our shared drive and file the pilot plan checklist. Vanessa — once you open the PC ticket, link it here.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Partner Success & Field Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: contoso_account_tiles_v1_mapped.csv (stub)

Subject: Contoso — Partner Center referral mapping and intake (finalized)

Hi Sean / Rachel —

Thanks — we completed the first-pass mapping and have opened the Partner Center intake ticket. Summary of decisions and next steps: 

Summary (short):
- Owner assignment logic: explicit_contoso_owner -> ms_signal -> regional_fallback (as Karthik described).
- Pilot: 50 accounts (US-centric) for 48-hour monitoring window.
- Manual review: 12 accounts flagged as "enterprise / delegated reseller" — those require MS account team approval before routing.

Deliverables attached: contoso_account_tiles_v1_mapped.csv (mapping), pc_referral_flow_v2.pdf (flow), contoso_onboarding_ma.pdf (master agreement stub).

Operational next steps and timeline:
1) Contoso to confirm the SFTP link & send any missing MS seller aliases (by EOD Thu).
2) We will file the Partner Center association (ticket PC-789342) — engineering check expected 3–5 business days. Link: https://partnercenter.microsoft.com/ticket/PC-789342
3) Pilot enablement: after association, we enable referral routing for pilot accounts (targeting Mon 9/13). Monitoring for 48 hours, then roll to the full set if no issues.
4) DocuSign: Contoso should sign the onboarding MA. DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/doc/ABC-Contoso-Onboarding

If that all sounds good we'll schedule a 30-minute kickoff next week to walk through the mapping and runbook.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Channel & Marketplace Ops
Redwood Inference
